## Description

In business, you can't control the traffic jams, the market fluctuations, or the unexpected hurdles. What you can control is your energy.

Running a business is a constant marathon. Employees leave, deals fall through, and problems arise every single day. Because of this, staying driven can feel like a heavy task if you are doing it all alone.

In this segment of the Badeaam Podcast, Dr. Ajit Marathe explains that to overcome the daily grind, you don't need just a strategy; you need an energy recharge. This is why having a support network like the Saturday Club is so vital. When you plug into a room filled with like-minded, positive entrepreneurs every 15 days, it charges your batteries for the road ahead.
